description_full: Callaway Golf Company designs, manufactures, and sells golf equipment, golf and lifestyle apparel, and other accessories in the United States, Europe, Asia, and Internationally. It operates in two business segments: Golf Equipment; and Apparel, Gear and Other. The company provides drivers, fairway woods, hybrids, irons, and wedges under the Callaway brands; packaged sets under the Callaway and Strata brands; and putters under Odyssey brand. It designs, manufactures, and sells golf clubs, golf balls, apparel, bags, and other accessories under TravisMathew and OGIO brand. It sells its products through golf retailers, sporting goods retailers, online retailers, mass merchants, department stores, third-party distributors, and merchants, and directly to consumers through its retail stores and websites. The company was formerly known as Topgolf Callaway Brands Corp. and changed its name to Callaway Golf Company in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Carlsbad, California.

financial_summary: Callaway Golf Company is a mid-cap consumer cyclical business with a $3.1B market cap on $2.1B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at -20% over the past three years and +9% annually across the full decade, and a shrinking top line is the hardest headwind any business can overcome.
Returns on capital run at 5% against a 8% cost of capital, which means the business is destroying value with every dollar it reinvests, with gross margins sitting at 42%.
The business throws off $302M in free cash flow — roughly 15 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 3.2× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and thin 2.1× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.
Shareholder yield is only 0.1%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 14% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
